_comment_far_idle: Far-zoom island tooltip, headline: nothing is running on this project right now. Keep short — it is the label on a sleeping-moon mark.
_comment_family_runners: Data-health banner: name of the dev-runner task data family when its fetch fails. 'Dev runner' is the app's name for engine-executed queued tasks (no terminal).
_comment_lane_personas: Mastermind mid-zoom island: label for the persona work lane. Short — it sits under a small icon.
_comment_lane_runners: Mastermind mid-zoom island: label for the dev-runner work lane (queued/running engine tasks). Short — it sits under a small icon.
_comment_lane_none: Mastermind mid-zoom island: shown in a work lane that currently has nothing running.
_comment_far_idle_hint: Far-zoom island tooltip, second clause explaining what 'nothing running' counted. 'Fleet' is the product's CLI-session feature — keep it capitalised and untranslated.
far_idle_hint: No Fleet session or persona is working on this project
_comment_far_active_one: Far-zoom island tooltip, headline when exactly 1 live process (Fleet session or persona) is running behind the project.
_comment_far_active_other: Far-zoom island tooltip, headline for 2+ live processes.
_comment_far_personas_one: Far-zoom island tooltip, breakdown item for the persona lane (singular).
_comment_far_personas_other: Far-zoom island tooltip, breakdown item for the persona lane (plural).
passport_demo: Demo project — the passport column arrives with live data. Scan projects in Factory to light this up.

athena_panel_unreadable_hint: Athena composed it in a shape this version does not understand. Reset it and ask her for a new one.
fleet_demo: Demo session — no live terminal behind this node.

soundings_help_title: Soundings: higher means it needs you more
soundings_help_move: move between stations, or readings inside one
soundings_help_open: open a station, lift a reading
soundings_help_file: the project file: live work, release plan, relations
soundings_help_related: follow a current to a related project
soundings_help_depth_l0: Portfolio: a buoy rises with urgency. 3 per alert, 1 per risk, 2 if the release is late, 2 if an agent waits for you, 3 if critical or 1 if warning, 1 if no monitoring is bound, a quarter per gap. The sounding figures 6, 2 and 1 mark the band edges.
soundings_help_depth_l1: Inside a station the same bands hold readings: Surface needs you, Shallows is not built, Mid-water is in progress, Deep is done. Lanes left to right: runtime, delivery, agentic, product.
soundings_unknown_note: Unknown means the check could not read this, not that the value is zero.
soundings_help_flag: An agent waits for your input
